FLUME Latent Space Explorer

FLUME encodes compound-loop execution traces into a 256-dimensional latent manifold using a β-VAE architecture: 
Input → Encoder → μ, σ (256D) → z ~ N(μ, σ²) → Decoder → Reconstruction
The optimal β (KL weight) is ≤ 0.01 — above β=0.020 the posterior collapses (KL → 0, decoder ignores z). Explore the latent geometry below.
